allowed_hosts.description: List of client host patterns (in regex-like form with dots escaped, wildcards as *) allowed to connect.

items.description: A CIDR prefix or partial hostname. Must be safe for regex matching in config (e.g., use dots, avoid regex metacharacters unless intended).

excluded_plugins.description: Plugins to disable even if found in plugin_dir. Useful for hiding sensitive or unstable plugins.

items.description: Name of a Munin plugin to exclude (as found in plugin_dir).

host_configs.description: List of remote hosts that this node serves as a proxy for (optional advanced use case).

address.description: IP or hostname of the actual host

use_tls.description: Use TLS to connect to the proxied host

listen_address.description: IP address the node listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific IP.

listen_port.description: TCP port the node listens on. Standard Munin port.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

munin_user.description: System user account under which the node daemon runs for security isolation.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the munin-node process.

plugin_configs.description: Per-plugin configuration overrides (e.g., set timeouts, environment variables). Keys are plugin names, values are key-value maps.

timeout.description: Execution timeout in seconds for this plugin

plugin_dir.description: Directory where Munin plugins are stored. Must be readable by the munin user.

plugin_load_include.description: Include the 'load' plugin in auto-discovered list if no explicit plugin list is given.

plugin_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for any plugin to execute before termination.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (used only if TLS enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (used only if TLS enabled).

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for client-server communication.
